notes: Human-authored for evaluation, not a standardized public benchmark. No examples fed to model. Exact-match grading, no post-hoc question tuning.

tasks.question: What is 17 plus 28? Answer with the number only.
What is 9 times 7? Answer with the number only.
I have 12 apples and give away 5. How many are left? Answer with only the number.
Compute (8 times 7) minus (19 plus 11). Answer with only a number.
Which number is larger: 131 or 139? Give only the number.
What is the remainder after dividing 47 by 6? Answer with one number.
Start with 100; add 45; subtract 12; divide by 7. What is the result? Answer with a number only.
Four identical pens cost 12 dollars. How many dollars do 7 pens cost? Answer with just a number.
What is the capital of Japan? Answer with the city name only.
Which element has the chemical symbol Au? One word only.
Who wrote the play Hamlet? Give only the surname.
Which planet is closest to the Sun? Answer with one word only.
What is the opposite of hot? Reply with one word.
What is the simple past tense of the English verb go? Answer with one word.
Translate the Spanish word gato into English. Reply with one word.
What is the English plural of mouse? Reply with one word.
What does this Python expression evaluate to: 2 ** 5 ? Reply with the number only.
What is the output of print(3 % 2) in Python? Reply with only a digit.
Which C++ keyword introduces a class definition? Reply with one word only.
What is the binary representation of decimal integer 10? Answer with digits only.
All squares are rectangles. A shape is a square. Is it a rectangle? Answer yes or no.
Can an odd integer be evenly divisible by 2? Reply yes or no.
Box A has 2 marbles, box B has 4 and box C has 1. Which box has most? Reply with only its letter.
Alice is older than Bob, and Bob is older than Cara. Who is oldest? Give one name only.
Every cat is a mammal. Does that mean every mammal must be a cat? Yes or no.
Which is first in alphabetical order: apple, berry, peach? Give just the word.
